instruction.text: Select all the things that make sound.

trainers.instruction: What happens when these objects make sound?

atoms.text: Select the strings to strum the guitar.

atoms.b: When guitar strings are strummed, they begin to ((++vibrate glow)). This vibration creates a ((++sound smell)).

trainers.instruction: Elias is trying to make a noise with his ruler. Read what he does and decide if the ruler will make a noise or not.

atoms.a: Elias places the ruler so it is balanced, very still, over the edge of the desk. Will it make a sound?

feedback.correct: When the ruler is balanced and still, no vibrations are created. Elias won’t hear any sound.

atoms.a: Elias decides to hold one end of the ruler on the desk and flick the other end with his finger. Will the ruler make a sound now?

correct.text: When Elias flicked the ruler, it vibrated and make a funny noise.
correct.sound: cartoon-boing When Elias flicked the ruler, it vibrated and made a funny noise.
